head: Tallied time tracker app for iPhone: one button to start and stop
dek: Tallied is a new 1.99 dollar time tracking app for iPhone and iPad: press Start when you begin a task and Stop when you finish, and it logs your day and week. It was number 66 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 14 November.
details: You can say how long a task should take and get an alert when you pass it, and the gaps between tasks show as personal time you can turn into work. There's a weekly chart by day and by client, a task list, a to-do list, companies for people with several clients, and CSV export and import. Your times are encrypted on the phone and the sync service only sees scrambled data; a recovery code adds a second device. It's made by Blokhaus Inc. and came out on 13 November.
where: iPhone and iPad, 1.99 dollars, out since 13 November
means: If you bill by the hour or want to see where your day goes, Tallied tracks it without projects, tags or timesheets to set up.
todo: Keep the recovery code somewhere safe: the listing says it's how you get your times back on a new phone.
